title: A jar of favorite memories
description: Small notes with a memory, an inside joke, or one thing you appreciate. A clean jar or envelope is enough.
personal: Add one note they can open on a hard day.
alternative: Fold notes into an envelope you already own.

title: The family recipe notebook
description: Collect a few loved recipes and the stories behind them. Leave space for the next family favorite.
personal: Include the person who taught you each recipe.
alternative: Use a spare notebook or share a digital document.

title: An afternoon, just for them
description: Plan a walk, a photo-sorting afternoon, or a favorite film you can already watch. Give it a real date.
personal: Choose the activity around something they keep mentioning.
alternative: Make a handwritten invitation instead of buying a voucher.

title: A book and a little reading ritual
description: Choose a book that matches an interest, add a bookmark, and suggest a cozy time to read. A good used copy can be lovely.
personal: Write why the book made you think of them on a separate note.
